Custom Home Building in Clearwater, KS

Clearwater's south Sedgwick County location — rural character, larger lots, and proximity to the Ninnescah River corridor — makes it one of the most appealing areas in the metro for homeowners who want to build on land rather than buy into a subdivision. Clearwater custom home builds are typically on larger parcels outside the small city center, on well and septic, with genuine rural character that you can't find in the established suburbs.

Wheatland Construction builds custom homes in Clearwater and south Sedgwick County. We're a Veterans Approved Builder (ID: 00899), Home Advisor Certified since 2019, and family-owned since 2018.

Building Custom in Clearwater

Rural lot builds: Most Clearwater custom builds are on rural parcels in unincorporated Sedgwick County. We work with Sedgwick County Planning and Zoning for permitting and understand the requirements for rural construction on well and septic.

Site considerations: South Sedgwick County's clay soils and Ninnescah River proximity create site conditions that matter for foundation design. We complete soil testing before foundation spec and design foundations appropriate for the specific lot — not a generic spec-home slab.

Well and septic coordination: We coordinate well drilling and septic system installation as part of the custom home build process. Our clients don't manage multiple contractors for site utilities.

Energy efficiency in a rural setting: Custom Clearwater homes are typically less connected to city utilities, which makes energy efficiency design more important. We build to current code with additional insulation options, quality window packages, and mechanical systems designed for efficient operation in a rural setting.

What We Build

Ranch homes, story-and-a-half designs, walkout basement plans, and two-story custom builds. All custom — not a catalog plan with your name attached. We design around your lot, your program, and your budget.

How We Approach Custom Home Building in Clearwater

Custom home building involves pre-construction planning before any permits are pulled - site assessment, soil report where required, architectural drawings, permit application, and financing confirmation. We walk every client through the full pre-construction phase before ground is broken.

Construction draws are tied to verified completion milestones. We communicate progress weekly and flag any schedule or cost changes before they become surprises.

Wheatland Construction has held Veterans Approved Builder status (ID: 00899) since we opened and has been Home Advisor Certified since 2019. We're licensed and insured in Kansas.

In Clearwater, the Ninnescah River corridor and southern Sedgwick County rural character shape both the housing stock and the renovation context.

Frequently Asked Questions About Custom Home Building in Clearwater

How much does a custom home cost to build in Clearwater, KS?

Clearwater custom home builds typically range from $220,000 to $550,000+ depending on square footage, finish level, and site complexity. Rural well-and-septic sites add site utility costs that subdivision lots don't carry. Written estimates with full scope detail.

Who handles permits for custom home building in Clearwater?

Most Clearwater area builds are in unincorporated Sedgwick County — permits through Sedgwick County Planning and Building. We handle all permitting, inspections, and coordination.

How long does it take to build a custom home in Clearwater?

10–16 months from permit issuance depending on design complexity and finish level. Site preparation and utility installation add time on rural parcels.

Do you handle well and septic coordination for Clearwater builds?

Yes — we coordinate well drilling and septic installation with licensed subcontractors as part of the build process. Rural site utilities are part of our scope.

Can you build on my Clearwater lot?

We review your lot for soil conditions, drainage, setback requirements, and utility access before committing to a build. Rural south Sedgwick County lots have more variability than subdivision lots.

Does a custom home add value compared to buying existing in Clearwater?

Building custom in Clearwater gives you a home designed for your family, on your land, built to current code — without the deferred maintenance and compromises of an older rural home. The value is in the fit, not just the appraised number.
